EC1: Previous exposure to drugs such as fingolimod [OR], natalizumab [OR], alemtuzumab [OR], mitoxantrone [OR] and ocrelizumab.
EC2: Positive hepatitis C [OR] or hepatitis B surface antigen test [OR] and/or hepatits B core antibody test for immunoglobulin G (IgG) [OR] and/or immunoglobulin M (IgM).
EC3: Current [OR] or previous history of immune deficiency disorders including a positive human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) result.
EC4: Currently receiving immunosuppressive [OR] or myelosuppressive therapy with, for example, monoclonal antibodies [OR], methotrexate [OR], cyclophosphamide [OR], cyclosporine [OR] or azathioprine [OR], or chronic use of corticosteroids.
EC5: History of tuberculosis [OR] , presence of active tuberculosis [OR], or latent tuberculosis
EC6: Evidence [OR] or suspect of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) [AND] in Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI).
EC7: Active malignancy [OR] or history of malignancy.
EC8: Other protocol defined exclusion criteria could apply.
